observations.title: Export UI source contracts separate generated files, initiated downloads, retention and verification
observations.detail: The assigned tests require a second confirmation for raw-key download; distinguish a blocked download from a generated encrypted file; check the exact saved bytes, including refusal of BOM-normalized input; and keep seller custody unchanged during verification. These are reviewed assertions, not executed outcomes.

observations.title: Seller tests bind asynchronous completion and storage changes to the reviewed identity
observations.detail: The test sources distinguish identical public keys installed in a new session revision, reject late cancelled recovery results, check temporary-buffer wiping, separate pre-commit write refusal from post-commit reporting, and preserve replacement ciphertext when a vault-deletion confirmation becomes stale.

observations.title: Settings tests preserve separate review, active policy and local privacy state
observations.detail: The source tests keep imported endpoints inactive during preview, require explicit consent for trust changes, bind endpoint status to the latest input/request, and ensure clipboard/privacy control changes do not persist unfinished sensitive endpoint edits. The candidate Settings tests additionally model blocked network actions for unacknowledged or corrupt profile storage.

observations.title: DOM, storage, timing and download substitutes limit what this round establishes
observations.detail: These sources use jsdom, in-memory stores, controlled promises, mocked clipboard/RPC ports and intercepted Blob/anchor handoffs; some flows lower KDF work for tests. DOM hiddenness and autocomplete attributes are asserted, but no browser, password-manager, real-disk retention, production-cost KDF or live-network behavior was verified. Imported locale/vector contents are not covered merely because tests reference them.

batches.detail: Read full App/AppLean and fragment UI tests. Source contracts cover core-route boundaries, invoice-fragment cleanup with retained navigation state, idle recoverability, downloaded-but-unverified backup distinctions, scope replacement races, focus and error recovery. No new confirmed finding.

Read full reconciliation UI, invoice, localization and quick-hide privacy tests. Source assertions cover preview versus activation, historical receipt/import distinctions, canonical-time matching, stale scan/preview guards, guarded writes, cross-tab reorg refresh, saturation, localization with redacted errors, and explicit history reveal. No new confirmed finding.

Read every assigned stealth-export component/UI test and SellerKeys master/recovery integration test. Tests cover raw-key second confirmation, address-bound reauthentication, disclosure of public header and RPC privacy, exact selected-source binding, cancellation and revision guards, blocked-download retry using the same generated file, exact saved-byte matching including BOM refusal, recovery-key disposal, retention/verification distinctions, master-replacement consent and cross-tab vault-deletion re-review. No new confirmed finding; referenced vector contents are not covered by imports.

Read all remaining SellerKeys and SellerPairing test sources. Tests cover recovery-operation ownership by exact session revision, refusal of late key installs, observable temporary-buffer wiping, same-file cancellation retry, passphrase/DOM clearing, step-up authorization, backup versus download distinctions, storage pre-commit refusal and post-commit reporting, cross-tab replacement/deletion compare-and-swap, public pairing preview without authority changes, and obsolete preview cancellation. No new confirmed finding.

Read the full base Settings and Settings exchange UI test sources, complete main-to-candidate diffs, and full RPC-result race, scan-privacy, and clipboard-privacy tests. Source assertions cover reviewed import consent, conservative trust changes, no imported-endpoint contact during preview, session-only RPC consent retained on invalid form submissions, network policy acknowledgement and corrupt-storage refusal, stale endpoint-response rejection, bounded scan settings, and separate UI privacy persistence without saving unfinished endpoint edits. No new confirmed finding.
